commit_message:
Fix token sidecar ingestion gaps

Warn on failed Codex drafter token-record copies, unsupported sidecar TOOL values, and failed lint-fix token subprocesses.

Append Python lint-fix Codex sidecars to NDJSON and ingest them into the active ledger even when the launcher fails, with implementation tmpdir routing isolated from stale parent env.

Document research Codex sidecar ingestion against the research ledger, add lint-fix-loop relevant-check routing, and refresh focused regression coverage.
